senses.gloss:
धिक् धिक्, an interjection:
 1. of dissatis-faction, Pie, Brāhmaṇ. 1, 35.
 2. of reproach, Shame, Pañc. 38, 12. With nom., voc., acc. (Draup. 9, 21). gen. (Rām. 6, 95, 40).
धिक्कार धिक्-कार, m. Contempt, Bhāg. P. 4, 14, 12.

† धिक्ष् धिक्ष् (properly a desiderat. of दह्), i. 1, Ātm.
 1. To kindle.
 2. To be weary.
 3. To live.
